{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.32

|gr1= Arrays

|descr= Removes a range of array elements from the given array. Modifies the original array, just like [[resize]] or [[set]].

|s1= array [[deleteRange]] [from, count]

|p1= array: [[Array]] of [[Anything]]

|p2= from: [[Number]] - array index to start selection from.

|p3= count: [[Number]] - number of array elements to remove. If the selected range exceeds source array boundaries, selection will be made up to the end of the array.

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
_arr = [1,2,3,4,5,6];
_arr deleteRange [1,4];
hint str _arr; // [1,6]
</sqf>

|seealso= [[deleteAt]] [[set]] [[resize]] [[select]] [[in]] [[find]] [[toArray]] [[toString]] [[forEach]] [[count]] [[pushBack]] [[pushBackUnique]] [[apply]] [[append]] [[sort]] [[param]] [[params]] [[arrayIntersect]] [[splitString]] [[joinString]]
